name: Vesper Row
tagline: Commercials, branded films and the people who make them.

directors.name: Tomas Brandt
directors.bio: Tomas plans car work like choreography: roads, weather and long light, shot for car brands and classic-car events across North America and Europe.

directors.name: June Okafor
directors.bio: A former track athlete, June directs sport from the inside: real athletes, real effort, the camera at their height and their speed.

directors.name: Ada Reyes-Hollis
directors.bio: Ada works in the space between product and feeling. Slow, precise tabletop work and fragrance films built on light, mist and texture.

directors.name: Lev Marsh
directors.bio: Lev came up through music videos and still shoots like it: smoke, hard light and one strong idea per film.

news.title: June Okafor joins the roster
body: June comes to Vesper Row after three years of documentary sport work. Her first spot with us, Round Nine for Kestrel Fight Co., was shot in one night in a working gym with a real fighter.
She is available for sport and performance work from January.

news.title: Overland: one road, one evening
body: Tomas Brandt shot Overland for Marrow Motor Co. on a single stretch of northern highway in one evening of long, low light.
One drone team, one camera car, and a crew of nine.

news.title: Stage B is open
body: Our second stage is finished: a black-box stage for fragrance, beauty and effects work, with full blackout and a haze-safe air system.
Book it with or without our crews. Details on the Space page.

space.name: Stage A
space.spec: Tabletop and product. 30 x 40 ft, daylight or blackout, motion-control rig.

space.name: Stage B
space.spec: Black box for fragrance, beauty and effects. Full blackout, haze-safe air.
